quote: We use cross-lingual machine reading comprehension (xMRC) as a simplified but representative scenario because: (1) It is a representative NLP task where models need to retrieve cross-lingual knowledge within the context; (2) The target knowledge to be retrieved is entirely within the context, so minimal extra knowledge recall is needed; (3) The model only has to copy part of the context as the answer, simplifying evaluation...
